tasks.label: Build Linux Static
tasks.command: docker build --tag salvium:build-env-linux --build-arg THREADS=$(nproc) --file Dockerfile.linux . && docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/salvium-gui" -w /salvium-gui salvium:build-env-linux sh -c 'make release-static -j$(nproc)'

tasks.label: Build Windows x64
tasks.command: docker build --tag salvium:build-env-windows --build-arg THREADS=$(nproc) -f Dockerfile.windows . && docker run --rm -v "${workspaceFolder}:/salvium-gui" -w /salvium-gui salvium:build-env-windows sh -c 'make depends root=/depends target=x86_64-w64-mingw32 tag=win-x64 -j$(nproc)'
